display.title: The Children Will Lead the Parade to Moshiach
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi promises the show will broadcast from Yerushalayim when Moshiach comes, and that Jewish children will lead the great parade out of golus.
display.summary_long: A talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, marking 341 weeks on the air. Uncle Yossi says the program will continue until Moshiach comes, and even after, broadcasting from Yerushalayim, because its purpose is to bring the word of Hashem to Jewish children. Quoting the Rebbe's words 'Ot ot kumt Moshiach', he urges everyone to pray and hope every day. Those who truly wait for Moshiach will be the first to greet him, will be carried on soft clouds to Yerushalayim, and will see the third Beis HaMikdash built by Hashem Himself. At the head of the grand parade out of golus will march the children of Tzivos Hashem, just as, our Sages say, the little children were the first to recognize Hashem when the Jews left Egypt.
display.lesson: Pray and hope for Moshiach every day; Jewish children will lead the way to the Geulah.

date.note: Date of episode 341; the talk itself says '341 weeks' on the air.

sources_cited.note: Quoted as the Rebbe shlita's words.
Cited as 'our Chachamim': the children were first to recognize Hashem at the Exodus.
Quoted as said every day in davening.
